args.command: udevadm trigger --subsystem-match=input --action=change 2>/dev/null || true; sleep 2; echo '=== xinput ==='; DISPLAY=:0 xinput list 2>&1 || true; echo '=== log ==='; grep -Ei 'libinput|Logitech|pointer' /var/log/Xorg.0.log 2>/dev/null | tail -n 80 || true; chvt 3 2>/dev/null || true

meta.summary: Refresh Xorg input devices and verify Mini mouse
